2019 Q2.bq: While there were several positives in the first half, which I will address shortly, these second-quarter results fell short of our expectations due primarily to a supply chain shortfall affecting the global launch of our Phantom X putter line and softer-than-anticipated club and footwear replenishment in Japan as trade partners prepare for upcoming new product launches.

2026 Q2.bq: Excluding the net refund benefit, adjusted EBITDA increased 12% in the first half, ahead of our expectations of high single-digit growth in both net sales and EBITDA during the first half as second quarter GTS metal shipments were greater than anticipated.
